# Kartikey Sharma

- [Projects](https://www.kartikeysharmaks.in/#projects): Showcase of shipped full-stack web builds, UI/UX designs, and mobile apps.
- [Education](https://www.kartikeysharmaks.in/#education): Background in formal training and self-taught certifications.
- [Work](https://www.kartikeysharmaks.in/#work): Timeline of professional career, contracts, and software engineering roles.
- [Skills](https://www.kartikeysharmaks.in/#skills): Developer stack and tool directory categorized by Frontend, Backend, Mobile, and Tools.
- [Testimonials](https://www.kartikeysharmaks.in/#testimonials): Recommendations and reviews from collaborators and clients.
